about: Mix-and-match sections for personal-brand service businesses — life, business, career, executive and branding coaches, consultants, counsellors/therapists/hypnotherapists, nutrition & weight-loss coaches, speakers and content creators — from 12 Dribbble full-page references (1–12.webp; shot links in _sources.json). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg. These pages sell a PERSON: use the lead's own portraits, speaking/session photos and their real story first, then lifestyle stock. Client counts, revenue figures, 'as seen in' logos, prices and credentials must come from FACTS — otherwise drop them. Therapy/counselling pages must not promise outcomes or imply medical treatment.
